mechanism: Original approved neutral lip-color silhouette, upper/lower alpha ownership with static alpha-over correction; rigid lower-lip translation. Source-assembly oral interiors behind alpha-only aperture. Identity UV, no scale, no replacement or opacity crossfade.

upper_lip.operation: Original approved neutral lip colors inside traced alpha silhouette; static shader coverage divides upper and lower ownership.

lower_lip.operation: Original approved neutral lip colors inside traced alpha silhouette; static shader coverage divides upper and lower ownership.

underlip_shadow.operation: Original approved neutral lip colors inside traced alpha silhouette; static shader coverage divides upper and lower ownership.

cavity.operation: Static canonical-mouth registration of immutable source-assembly interior; transparent edge guard where moving. Identity UV at runtime.

upper_teeth.operation: Static canonical-mouth registration of immutable source-assembly interior; transparent edge guard where moving. Identity UV at runtime.

lower_teeth.operation: Static canonical-mouth registration of immutable source-assembly interior; transparent edge guard where moving. Identity UV at runtime.

tongue.operation: Static canonical-mouth registration of immutable source-assembly interior; transparent edge guard where moving. Identity UV at runtime.

estimates.neutral_lips: Source-authored visible lip colors recut with a tight alpha silhouette including the under-lip shadow. Boundary coverage is estimated; no surrounding rectangular skin patch travels.
estimates.oral_interiors: Previously registered source-assembly cavity, teeth and tongue reused; they are not claimed visible in the canonical neutral.

upper_teeth_correction.reason: Occlude the source arch top under the fixed upper lip; remove detached dark gap and side-first dental-outline reveal. Visible crown alpha and boundaries remain source-derived; tooth-only whitening is documented separately.
upper_teeth_correction.estimate: Static registration is inferred because the canonical neutral does not expose teeth. No missing tooth pixels are generated.

mouth_limit.reason: Conservative dark-opening bound measured against user screenshot at matching facial scale. Existing shape is evaluated at the capped control, never compressed or scaled.

tooth_whitening.operation: Neutral RGB = round(clamp(135 + 0.5 * Rec709 source luminance, 0, 255)); alpha and source tooth boundaries retained. Static derivative only.
